Lower Text: [Security] Return 1 Digimon card from your trash to your hand, and add this card to your hand.
Upper Text: This card is also treated as having [Plug-In] in its name. While you have a Tamer in play, you may use this card without meeting its color requirements.

[Main] Choose 1 of your level 6 Digimon. Ignoring digivolution requirements and without paying the cost, it may digivolve into a level 6 Digimon card in your hand with a different name that includes the chosen Digimon's name.
